My highschool found out, I was sent to a mental hospital again. Had therapy once more. Diagnosed with bi-polar depression. I was given meds. I stopped going once again after a while. I was convinced I was fine. I stopped hurting myself as often. I had friends who supported me.

It was a scary experience, I kept telling them I wasn’t crazy. It wasn’t till I had to get counseling that I was diagnosed with depression and anxiety. I wasn’t really sure what any of that meant at the time. I hated counseling. I would lie about my feelings and thoughts.
